title: Conference Board Consumer Confidence Index (March 2027), 10:00 a.m. ET
source: EST: the publisher's own standing rule, restated on conference-board.org/topics/consumer-confidence fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 332,019 bytes after one 301) — "The Conference Board publishes the Consumer Confidence Index (R) at 10 a.m. ET on the last Tuesday of every month." 2027-03-30 is the last Tuesday of March 2027. Verified for MARCH specifically against three primary-sourced March editions, each fetched direct 2026-09-06 at HTTP 200 and each checked against its own "Source: March <year> Consumer Confidence Survey" line and its own "Updated:" date rather than trusted by slug: CCI-Mar-2023 (Updated 2023-03-28, 1,159,544 bytes), CCI-Mar-2024 (2024-03-26, 1,418,918 bytes), CCI-Mar-2025 (2025-03-25, 342,030 bytes). Every one is the last Tuesday of its March, and ALL THREE are double-sourced by the preceding February edition's own next-release line -- CCI-Feb-2023 "The next release is Tuesday, March 28 at 10 AM ET", CCI-Feb-2024 "Tuesday, March 26th", CCI-Feb-2025 "Tuesday, March 25th". No March-2027 announcement exists yet, so this is the publisher's rule applied forward against a verified March record rather than a posted date. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: PROPOSED by the consumer-confidence-2027-02-23 initial-research sweep (2026-09-06) as the REPLICATION INSTANCE for its de-confounded null; that proposal file is now shadowed by this canonical one and was read before it was written. INITIAL RESEARCH 2026-09-06 (docs/research/events/consumer-confidence-2027-03-30.md) CONFIRMS THE NULL AND UPGRADES THE CONTROL RULE THAT PROTECTS IT. The pipeline first reproduced the 02-23 sibling's clean-day medians exactly (n=51: SPY 0.910, QQQ 1.379, XLY 1.399, XRT 1.678, AMZN 2.154, AAPL 1.731, XLF 1.119, TLT 0.961, VIX 18.560; 0 of 9), then found the sibling's own control discipline is NOT SUFFICIENT for this month. MARCH IS THE WIDEST MONTH IN THE SAMPLE -- all 132 March sessions since 2021 clear p<0.05 on 9 of 9 vs the rest of the year (SPY 1.291/0.936, VIX close 21.840/17.750, both p<0.0001), more than double February's 4 of 9. Against other March sessions the six March CB days look significantly NARROW -- 3 of 9 (SPY 0.662/1.304 p=0.0301, QQQ p=0.0364, AMZN p=0.0215) -- which the sibling's month-level control would have read as an effect. IT IS POSITION-IN-MONTH, NOT THE PRINT: March's width is FRONT-LOADED (last 5 March sessions vs earlier March sessions, 6 of 9, SPY 1.019/1.353 p=0.0040, VIX 19.505/22.965 p=0.0012), and the last-Tuesday rule puts this release in the final week BY CONSTRUCTION. Against other LATE-March sessions, March CB days are 0 of 9 (SPY 0.662/1.039, p=0.2650, n=6). So the correct control for a fixed-position monthly release is the same WEEK of the same month, not the month. The quarter-end story is separately measured and empty: quarter-end-window sessions are QUIETER not wilder (3 of 9, XRT p=0.0055), and March CB days vs other quarter-end sessions are 0 of 9. CB days EXCLUDING March are 0 of 9 too, so March was never carrying the sibling's null. TWO CORRECTIONS to the proposal that filed this id. (1) Its "first edition whose panel opens after the March SEP meeting" is wrong twice: sourced March cut-off lags are 8/8/6 days, so the 2027 panel opens ~03-01, two weeks BEFORE the March 16-17 decision. What is true is the mirror image -- in all three sourced Marches the panel CLOSED before the decision (cut-offs 2023-03-20 vs a 03-22 decision, 2024-03-18 vs 03-20, 2025-03-19 vs a 03-19 decision), whereas a 2027 cut-off of ~03-22/03-24 falls 5-7 days AFTER the 03-17 SEP decision. (2) Its Good Friday flag has ZERO precedent -- Easter 2027 is 03-28, and in 2021-2026 no Good Friday preceded a March CB print (2024's fell on 03-29, three days after that print), so the shortened-week effect cannot be measured and licenses nothing. Revision rule extends to a third month: March restates February 3 of 3 (102.9->103.4 +0.5, 106.7->104.8 -1.9 stated, 98.3->100.1 +1.8 derived), and Feb-2024's Expectations was restated 79.8->76.3, a 3.5-point move ACROSS the Board's own 80.0 recession threshold. Sourced March levels (headline/Present Situation/Expectations): 2023 104.2/151.1/73.0, 2024 104.7/151.0/73.8, 2025 92.9/134.5/65.2 (a 12-year Expectations low). CCI-Mar-2021, CCI-Mar-2022 and CCI-Mar-2026 returned HTTP 200 while serving the current August 2026 edition (332,019 bytes) -- the same silent-substitution class the 02-23 sibling recorded.
